story: Bilski's Lawn Care was created in the summer of 2020, in the middle of the Covid shutdowns. The goal from the beginning was to give residents of the Luzerne County area a high-quality landscaping company they could actually rely on — one that answers the phone, quotes in writing, and turns up on the day it said it would. We started with the basics: lawn maintenance, hedge trimming and mulch installs. Six seasons on we have grown into paver patios, segmental retaining walls, drainage and erosion work, and commercial snow and ice management through the winter. Ryan still walks the properties and puts the quotes together himself. The company now holds a 4.9-star rating across 40 reviews, and most new work comes from neighbours of people we have already worked for — which is the only marketing we have ever really trusted.
